title: Directing an AI Coding Tool
description: Learn how to specify requirements, structure prompts for reliable execution, and guide AI tools like Claude Code without typing every line — maximizing output within your energy envelope.

title: What Actually Changes
description: Say precisely which parts of development an AI coding tool takes over, which stay with you, and where accountability sits regardless of who typed the diff.

title: The Executable Spec
description: Write a specification precise enough that whether its output is right can be settled without asking you.

title: Context Is the Whole Job
description: Assemble the context a tool needs to produce code that actually fits the codebase it has to live in.

title: Reading the First Draft
description: Decide within minutes whether generated output should be refined, rewritten, or thrown away.

title: Knowing When to Take Over
description: Recognize the situations where directing a tool costs more than writing the code yourself.
